=== OUTBOX account= recipients=primary@example.com ntfy=// reason=this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit
Dedup: acctchange|primary@example.com|primary@example.com|The rego was taken off the permit "Visitor" from the quick picker. It now has no rego; nothing is covered on that permit until a rego is set or scheduled.|email|primary@example.com
Subject: A change was made to your p.stonn setup

The rego was taken off the permit "Visitor" from the quick picker. It now has no rego; nothing is covered on that permit until a rego is set or scheduled.

If that was expected, nothing to do.
If it wasn't, open p.stonn — the Activity page lists every change and who made it, and you can review who has shared access in Settings.

We have also told sam@example.com (by email).

https://p.stonn.org/activity
